## The checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` is clean
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` is clean
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] The new behaviour has a test
- [ ] There is no long dash in the sources and in the documentation
- [ ] No secret, no token and no private data in the diff
